evidence_boundary: Offline API doubles do not certify native Fusion behavior or competitor superiority

Direct designs without original joint geometry or timeline access
Rigid as-built joints with null geometry
As-built current transform precedes obsolete geometry
Ordinary and as-built revolute, continuous and slider motions agree
Suppressed mechanics differ from hidden joint markers
Current-pose revolute and slider limits preserve physical travel
Nested ordinary and as-built root-context joints
Repeated component instances retain distinct posed mesh targets
Direct root-body geometry and mass exclude assembly descendants
Mixed parent and child bodies share exact visible geometry and mass selection

Link, joint, visual, collision, CoM and inertia frames

cases.limitation: The emitted tree does not enforce the original closed-chain constraint

cases.title: Fusion motion links converted into affine mimic relations
cases.limitation: Explicit motion_links=mimic preserves affine delta coordinates, effective independent limits and derived follower states; native phase/context and original CAD remain unverified; bounded Ball and Humble nonzero-offset control reject

cases.title: Mesh-only input with explicit density or supplied central SI physics
cases.limitation: Density requires one validated embedded closed shell per body before STL quantization; supplied central SI physics permits positive-area planar MeshBody visuals without invented thickness. Selected non-solid BRep bodies are individually named rejections, not surface-BRep conversion support; mixed links cannot hide them behind aggregate mass. Native MeshBody face-material adaptation remains explicitly unsupported; live Fusion and original-CAD proof remain separate gates; see docs/mesh-inputs.md

cases.title: Bodyless assembly endpoints and reference-frame links
cases.limitation: Explicit frame kind has no mass, geometry or STL. Containment does not weld descendants. Historical null/tombstone vendor semantics and original CAD remain unverified

cases.title: Collision-safe Unicode source aliases retain mesh and physics association
cases.limitation: Aliases depend on the selected identity set. Native linked revision and original CAD behavior remain unverified

cases.title: Opt-in conservative convex-cell collision preserves visual bytes and CAD physics
cases.limitation: One exact-validated embedded shell only. Multiple bodies, multiple shells and cavities reject. Coarse cells may close narrow gaps; no dynamics or practical performance guarantee

cases.title: Cylindrical, planar, pin-slot and ball joint decomposition
cases.limitation: Explicit generalized_joints=decompose lowers supported compounds into primitive chains and massless frames; Ball additionally requires an export-local chart and rejects native bounds or coupling; native Fusion and original CAD remain unverified

cases.title: Distinct materials and textures per body or face
cases.limitation: Opt-in validated OBJ/MTL PNG/JPEG assets preserve diffuse channels, opacity, UV association and resource bytes; visual_meshes=per_body emits one separate visual/file per selected BRep body with strict or diffuse-subset materials; combined remains the default; subset losses remain explicit; native MeshBody face materials, appearance precedence, arbitrary shaders, procedural baking and render equivalence are not certified

cases.title: Explicit global rotation, serial common-normal frames and spectral inertia floor
cases.limitation: Default-off policies run after tree reduction and coupling; output reference carries nonidentity root pose; DH rejects compounds, branches, fixed spacers and closures; flooring is a recorded physics change, not controller-stability proof

cases.title: True single convex hull collision distinct from voxel cells
cases.limitation: Default closed_shell requires one validated embedded closed shell per link; explicit triangle_vertices accepts finite nonzero-area triangles from multiple bodies without verifying source topology and fills gaps/cavities; both use the same exact source-float32 hull with zero vertex rounding and bounded work/pieces/bytes; density and decomposition remain strict; no native accuracy, dynamics or practical performance guarantee
